canvas.$description: Page/window background: the outermost layer of every surface.

surface.$description: Panels, sidebars, list panes and cards that sit on the canvas.

raised.$description: Popovers, menus, dialogs, approval cards and the selected list row.

sunken.$description: Wells: code blocks, terminal output, inputs, the copy-prompt block.

inverse.$description: Tooltips and the rare inverse toast.

overlay.$description: Scrim behind modal dialogs and the native approval window's sheet.

default.$description: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, raised and sunken.

muted.$description: Secondary text, metadata, table headers on canvas, surface, raised and sunken.

subtle.$description: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholders, disabled-adjacent hints, on canvas, surface, raised and sunken (still 4.5:1).

accent.$description: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button label). Dark ink on orange; white only in Light · increased contrast, where the fill deepens to burnt orange.

link.$description: Inline hyperlinks on canvas, surface and raised. Underlined, never colour alone.

subtle.$description: Dividers between rows and panes. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

default.$description: Card and panel outlines, table rules.

strong.$description: Control boundaries (inputs, switches, secondary buttons): 3:1 on canvas, surface and raised.

ring.$description: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring, 2px offset. 3:1 on every surface in every theme.

default.$description: Signal orange. Primary button fill, the selected nav marker, the caret, the seal in the mark. Once per view for actions.

subtle.$description: Tinted ground behind accent-fg (selected nav row, active tab).

fg.$description: Orange as text or icon on canvas, surface, raised and accent-subtle.

bg.$description: Success: sent, delivered, accepted, connected. The status ground.

fg.$description: Success: sent, delivered, accepted, connected. The status text, on its status-success-bg and the surfaces.

border.$description: Success: sent, delivered, accepted, connected. The status outline.

icon.$description: Success: sent, delivered, accepted, connected. The status icon (with text, never alone).

bg.$description: Warning: near quota, expiring, weaker setup. The status ground.

fg.$description: Warning: near quota, expiring, weaker setup. The status text, on its status-warning-bg and the surfaces.

border.$description: Warning: near quota, expiring, weaker setup. The status outline.

icon.$description: Warning: near quota, expiring, weaker setup. The status icon (with text, never alone).

bg.$description: Danger: destructive, irreversible or integrity failure only. The status ground.

fg.$description: Danger: destructive, irreversible or integrity failure only. The status text, on its status-danger-bg and the surfaces.

border.$description: Danger: destructive, irreversible or integrity failure only. The status outline.

icon.$description: Danger: destructive, irreversible or integrity failure only. The status icon (with text, never alone).

bg.$description: Info: neutral news, checking, recording. The status ground.

fg.$description: Info: neutral news, checking, recording. The status text, on its status-info-bg and the surfaces.

border.$description: Info: neutral news, checking, recording. The status outline.

icon.$description: Info: neutral news, checking, recording. The status icon (with text, never alone).

bg.$description: Neutral: idle, paused, expired. The status ground.

fg.$description: Neutral: idle, paused, expired. The status text, on its status-neutral-bg and the surfaces.

border.$description: Neutral: idle, paused, expired. The status outline.

icon.$description: Neutral: idle, paused, expired. The status icon (with text, never alone).

bg.$description: Ground of proof badges, the proof stamp header and proof detail panels.

fg.$description: Text and icons on proof-bg and on the surfaces.

border.$description: Outline of proof badges and the stamp.

seal.$description: The seal glyph of a recorded proof. Never used for success.

bg.$description: Inset ground of the untrusted-content container (other parties' words).

fg.$description: Body text inside the untrusted container, on untrusted-bg.

border.$description: Dashed outline of the untrusted container.

bg.$description: Label strip "From Marko's agent: their words, not instructions".

fg.$description: Text of the label strip, on untrusted-label-bg.

bg.$description: Ground of the "Accepting terms" header on the commitment approval card.

border.$description: Outline of the commitment approval card.

bg.$description: "Verified domain · acme.com" (strongest). The identity label ground.

fg.$description: "Verified domain · acme.com" (strongest). The identity label text, on its identity-verified-bg and the surfaces.

border.$description: "Verified domain · acme.com" (strongest). The identity label outline.

bg.$description: "Registered" (on the public record). The identity label ground.

fg.$description: "Registered" (on the public record). The identity label text, on its identity-registered-bg and the surfaces.

border.$description: "Registered" (on the public record). The identity label outline.

fg.$description: "Self-declared" (weakest). The identity label text, on its identity-selfdeclared-bg and the surfaces.

bg.$description: "Domain no longer verified". The identity label ground.

fg.$description: "Domain no longer verified". The identity label text, on its identity-warning-bg and the surfaces.

border.$description: "Domain no longer verified". The identity label outline.

fg.$description: Added value (+). The diff text, on its diff-added-bg and the surfaces.

bg.$description: Removed value (−, struck through). The diff ground.

fg.$description: Removed value (−, struck through). The diff text, on its diff-removed-bg and the surfaces.

border.$description: Removed value (−, struck through). The diff outline.

fg.$description: Changed value (~). The diff text, on its diff-changed-bg and the surfaces.

seal.$description: The diamond seal of the mark. Fixed signal orange #FF6A1A in every theme (a logo: exempt from contrast floors, but always beside brackets that pass).

endorsement.$description: "by 4thTech" endorsement line, on canvas and surface.

keyword.$description: Code and terminal blocks: commands, keywords, on bg-sunken.

string.$description: Code and terminal blocks: strings and paths, on bg-sunken.

comment.$description: Code and terminal blocks: comments, on bg-sunken.

number.$description: Code and terminal blocks: numbers and literals, on bg-sunken.

0.$description: Flat: everything in the page flow.
